name: Novel Slot Detection (NSD) Benchmark
description: Existing slot filling models can only recognize pre-defined in-domain slot types from a limited slot set. In the practical application, a reliable dialogue system should know what it does not know. In this paper, we introduce a new task, Novel Slot Detection (NSD), in the task-oriented dialogue system. NSD aims to discover unknown or out-of-domain slot types to strengthen the capability of a dialogue system based on in-domain training data. Besides, we construct two public NSD datasets, propose several strong NSD baselines, and establish a benchmark for future work. Finally, we conduct exhaustive experiments and qualitative analysis to comprehend key challenges and provide new guidance for future directions.
typical_sota_score: 50–80% F1 (varies by dataset and experimental setup)
reputation: Adopted as a targeted benchmark in the dialogue/NLU community for out-of-domain/novel-slot detection research.
notes: Task-sensitive to ontology and thresholding; moderate dataset sizes; not an LLM-native benchmark (focused on slot-filling/NLU models).
